metadata.note: Command teardown of ./repoloop.sh — the top-level shim (three-line bash) and the runtime/scripts/repoloop.py factory it wraps. The shim's only jobs: set errexit, resolve REPOLOOP_ROOT, exec python3 on repoloop.py with --repo and $@ forwarded. All logic lives in repoloop.py: discover() enumerates the intro trilogy, every SKILL.md, every case-branch in art (via ART_SOURCES), every executable runtime/scripts/*.py and runtime/qc/*.py, plus command-setup and command-repoloop. merge_queue() marks items whose source_sha256 or feedback_sha256 changed as pending. build_one() snapshots the parent toolkit into workspaces/<slug>/toolkit/ via snapshot_toolkit(), writes a per-episode settings.json (worker_settings() — Read/Glob/Grep/Bash + writes only in workspace+reel; deny git push, gh, curl, wget, ssh; deny .env/.ssh/.aws/.config/gcloud reads), strips ANTHROPIC_* env vars in worker_environment(), spawns 'claude -p PROMPT' foreground in a new session group, and verify_film() reads the beat sheet + probes the MP4 to enforce the shape gates (>=8 beats, Kokoro am_onyx, ClaudeComposerAsk cold open, HesitantWriter beat 2, greeting 'your turn' penultimate, ffprobe dims match aspect, audio mean_volume > -40dB, matching VISUAL-REVIEW.json with the current run_id). Modes: default single-drain; --forever watch loop with 10-minute rescan; --dry prints inventory; --prepare writes briefs/EXAMPLE-SOURCES.json without invoking Claude; --once builds one; --status reads queue.json + worker.lock; --stop writes .repoloop/STOP; --start detaches a supervisor; --shorts-only runs the derivative cut-first queue against completed native portraits; --landscape-only skips vertical; --only <id> targets a single film. All demo output in demo/RUN-LOG.txt is verbatim from this workstation, captured against the live repository — the --status block literally shows this very reel building (id=command-repoloop). Playlist adaptation for @HumanitariansAI: composer folder chip reads @HumanitariansAI; outro card is the locked ClaudeTitleOutro with hardcoded @NikBearBrown handle per OUTRO-LOCK.md — flagged in README.md for the human reviewer before publication. No paid API, no upload, no network calls. episode.source_sha256 a7d5a3c3251ab4558978e081ba9f53dc400caba2cf38ad24eb1cd1905b613a24.

beats.role_note: FRAMEWORK — the three-line shim. verbatim from repoloop.sh:1-10.
beats.narration_text: The shell entrypoint is three lines. Set errexit, resolve its own directory, and exec Python on runtime slash scripts slash repoloop dot py, forwarding every argument. There is no logic in bash. The factory lives in the Python file.

props.title: repoloop.sh — three real lines
props.code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# repoloop.sh — build the Brutalist/Liam playlist, one fresh Claude session per film.
# Default: drain the queue. --forever watches for new skills and feedback.
# --dry lists coverage without writes; --prepare creates briefs without invoking Claude.
# --once builds one film; --status reads progress; --stop requests a graceful stop.
# --shorts-only selects the isolated cut-first queue; every Short must be < 3:00.
set -euo pipefail
REPOLOOP_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
exec python3 "$REPOLOOP_ROOT/runtime/scripts/repoloop.py" --repo "$REPOLOOP_ROOT" "$@"

# Three functional lines, six comment lines. No option parsing in bash;
# all flag dispatch lives in runtime/scripts/repoloop.py.
props.sparkLine: Three real lines. No logic in bash.

beats.role_note: FRAMEWORK — the queue lifecycle. discover → merge_queue → build_one → verify_film. States: pending → building → review_ready | retrying.
beats.narration_text: The factory has one shape. Discover the inventory from the toolkit itself — the intro trilogy, every SKILL dot m d, every case branch in the art dispatcher, every executable runtime and Q C script. Merge that inventory into the on-disk queue, marking anything with changed source or feedback as pending. Then, for each pending item, snapshot the toolkit into an isolated workspace and spawn one Claude worker under a fail-closed sandbox.

props.title: repoloop.py — the loop
props.code:
# discover() enumerates the film inventory from the toolkit:
def discover(repo):
    items = []
    for key, title, brief in INTRO:                # 3 onboarding
        add(key, title, 'onboarding', ...)
    for source in sorted(repo.glob('skills/*/**/SKILL.md')):
        add('skill-'+name, ...)                    # every skill
    for line in (repo/'art').read_text().splitlines():
        # every case-branch in the art dispatcher becomes a film
        add('command-'+name, ...)
    add('command-setup', ...); add('command-repoloop', ...)
    for d in ('runtime/scripts','runtime/qc'):     # executable utils
        for source in sorted((repo/d).glob('*.py')): add(...)
    return items

# merge_queue() marks changed items pending; preserves old renders.
# build_one() snapshots the toolkit, spawns claude, verify_film().
# The main loop drains items whose retry_at <= now, serial, one lock.

beats.role_note: FRAMEWORK — the sandbox. worker_settings() + worker_environment(). Verbatim from repoloop.py:268-346.
beats.narration_text: The worker's rights are constrained. Read anywhere it needs. Edit only inside its scratch workspace and its reel folder. Bash is allowed — but git push, g h, curl, wget, and s s h are denied outright. Dot e n v, dot s s h, dot a w s, and dot config slash gcloud are denied for reads. The worker's Anthropic environment variables are stripped so no A P I key can slip in. Kokoro is pinned to the local model. No M C P servers.

props.title: worker_settings + worker_environment — the sandbox
props.code:
# repoloop.py — every Claude subprocess boots with THIS settings.json
def worker_settings(repo, workspace, folder, fellows):
    return {'disableAllHooks': True,
        'permissions': {'defaultMode': 'dontAsk',
            'allow': ['Read', 'Glob', 'Grep', 'Bash',
                      f'Edit(/{workspace}/**)', f'Edit(/{folder}/**)'],
            'deny':  ['Read(**/.env)', 'Read(~/.ssh/**)',
                      'Read(~/.aws/**)', 'Read(~/.config/gcloud/**)',
                      'Bash(git push *)', 'Bash(gh *)',
                      'Bash(curl *)', 'Bash(wget *)', 'Bash(ssh *)']},
        'sandbox': {'enabled': True, 'failIfUnavailable': True,
            'autoAllowBashIfSandboxed': True,
            'allowUnsandboxedCommands': False,
            'filesystem': {'allowWrite': [str(workspace), str(folder)],
                'denyWrite': [str(repo/'runtime'), str(repo/'skills'),
                               str(repo/'.git'), str(fellows)],
                'denyRead': ['~/.ssh', '~/.aws',
                              '~/.config/gcloud', str(repo/'.env')]},
            'network': {'allowedDomains': ['localhost', '127.0.0.1'],
                        'allowLocalBinding': True}}}

# ANTHROPIC_* and *_API_KEY are stripped before spawn:
def worker_environment(repo):
    for k in list(env):
        if k.endswith('_API_KEY') or k in ('ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN',
                'ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL', 'CLAUDECODE', ...): env.pop(k)
props.sparkLine: Locked writes. Locked env. No MCP.

beats.role_note: MECHANISM — verify_film() fail-closed gate. Verbatim structure from repoloop.py:396-483.
beats.narration_text: This is the fail-closed gate. Verify film reads the beat sheet for both aspects. Fewer than eight beats — refuse. Non-Liam voice — refuse. First beat not Claude Composer Ask — refuse. Second beat missing Hesitant Writer — refuse. Penultimate greeting not Your Turn — refuse. Output M P 4 dimensions must match the requested aspect exactly. Audio must decode above minus forty d B. And a matching A I visual-review record with the current run I D must exist. The refusal is the whole point of the command.

props.title: verify_film — every raise is a refusal
props.code:
# repoloop.py — the fail-closed gate. Runs after 'claude' exits 0.
def verify_film(folder, item, dimensions):
    for aspect, size in dimensions.items():
        sheet = read_json(reel/'beat_sheet.json', {})
        md, beats = sheet['metadata'], sheet['beats']
        min_beats = 3 if aspect == 'short' else 8
        if len(beats) < min_beats or md.get('playlist') != 'Brutalist' \
                or md.get('voice_kokoro', md.get('voice')) != 'am_onyx':
            raise BuildError(f'{aspect}: missing film / voice')
        # cold open + hesitant writer + Your Turn — three shape gates
        if not patterns[0].startswith('ClaudeComposerAsk'):     raise ...
        if 'HesitantWriter' not in patterns[1]:                  raise ...
        if beats[-2]['shot']['remotion']['props']['greeting'] \
               .lower().strip() not in ('your turn', 'your turn.'): raise ...
        # ffprobe dims — must match native size exactly, no upscaled crop
        if (video['width'], video['height']) != tuple(size): raise ...
        # audio must actually be there
        if float(mean_volume) <= -40: raise ...
        # matching AI visual-review, current run_id, current beat_sheet SHA
        if review['run_id'] != item['run_id']: raise ...
props.sparkLine: Every raise is a refusal. The refusal is the point.

beats.role_note: FALSIFIABILITY — an unknown --only id. Verbatim from demo/RUN-LOG.txt. Guard fires BEFORE the queue is touched.
beats.narration_text: One failure worth showing. Ask the loop for an inventory I D that does not exist. The guard fires immediately: Unknown dash dash only I D, inspect dash dash dry. Exit two, no queue mutation, no worker spawned. Recovery is one command — dash dash dry — read the real slugs and try again. The loop's contract is that unknown work is never work.

beats.role_note: VERDICT — the whole surface, in the order you touch it.
beats.narration_text: So — repoloop dot sh. A three-line shim over a serial film factory. Six moving parts, in the order you touch them: the shim, discover, merge queue, snapshot toolkit, sandboxed worker, verify film. No parallelism. No auto-publish. No A P I-key fallback. A stop file gracefully terminates. A worker lock forbids duplicates. Six things — nothing else.

props.artifactHeading: repoloop.sh — the whole surface, in the order you touch it
artifactLines: the shim — 3 bash lines; sets errexit, resolves REPOLOOP_ROOT, execs python3 runtime/scripts/repoloop.py --repo $ROOT $@.
discover() — inventory derived from the toolkit itself: intro trilogy + skills/*/SKILL.md + case-branches in art + runtime & qc executables.
merge_queue() — reconciles inventory with .repoloop/queue.json; source_sha256 or feedback_sha256 change ⇒ status=pending, old renders preserved.
snapshot_toolkit() — copies runtime + skills + brands + docs into workspaces/<slug>/toolkit/; baseline SHA-256 map; symlinks node_modules.
worker_settings() + spawn — sandboxed 'claude -p PROMPT'; ANTHROPIC_* stripped; deny git push/gh/curl/wget/ssh; writes only workspace + reel.
verify_film() — fail-closed shape + ffprobe + audio + AI visual-review gate; refusal is the whole reason the command exists. Never publishes.

DO NOT run --once, --forever, --start, or --stop.
